_comment: Deterministic fixture for the custodian-sign -> verify_by_address round-trip. Private key is TEST-ONLY (never a real custodian key) and exists solely to pin the crypto contract; do not reuse it, do not log it. signer_address is derived from the public key of private_key_hex via keccak256(pubkey[1:])[12:]. expected_signature is an Ethereum personal_sign over the exact UTF-8 payload string.
